#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct FastIO {
    std::istream& in;
    FastIO(std::istream& inStream) : in(inStream) {}
    std::string read() {
        std::string token;
        while (!(in >> token)) {
            // do nothing, just wait for input
        }
        return token;
    }
    int readInt() {
        int val;
        in >> val;
        return val;
    }
    long long readLong() {
        long long val;
        in >> val;
        return val;
    }
};

class Computation {
public:
    std::ostream& out;
    FastIO& io;

    Computation(std::ostream& outStream, FastIO& ioRef) : out(outStream), io(ioRef) {}

    void execute(int all, int t) {
        int n = io.readInt();
        int mod = io.readInt();

        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> dp(n, std::vector<long long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= i; c++) {
                    if (j - c >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - c];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) dp[i][j] += mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> prefixSum(n, std::vector<long long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;
                prefixSum[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        std::vector<long long> factorial(501 * 501, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)factorial.size(); i++) {
            factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> nCr(501, std::vector<long long>(501, 0));
        nCr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 500; i++) {
            nCr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - 2; i++) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long long comb = (nCr[n][pre] * factorial[pre]) % mod;
            long long total = 0;
            std::vector<long long>& last = dp[cnt - 2];
            long long ssum = 0;
            long long totalSum = 0;
            for (int j = 2; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                total += prefixSum[cnt - 2][j - 2] * (cnt - 1);
                total %= mod;

                long long val = last[j] * total;
                answer += val;
                answer %= mod;

                ssum += prefixSum[cnt - 2][j - 2];
                if (j - cnt - 1 >= 0) ssum -= prefixSum[cnt - 2][j - cnt - 1];
                ssum = (ssum + mod) % mod;

                total -= ssum;
                total = (total + mod) % mod;
            }
            answer += (prefixSum[cnt - 2][0] * comb) % mod;
            answer %= mod;
        }
        out << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    FastIO io(std::cin);
    std::ostream& out = std::cout;
    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        Computation comp(out, io);
        comp.execute(T, t);
    }
    return 0;
}
